mapper.insert: INSERT INTO receipt (receipt_no, company_id, customer_id, order_id, order_no, receipt_date, amount, payment_method, bank_account, allocated_amount, unallocated_amount, remark) VALUES (#{receiptNo}, #{companyId}, #{customerId}, #{orderId}, #{orderNo}, #{receiptDate}, #{amount}, #{paymentMethod}, #{bankAccount}, #{allocatedAmount}, #{unallocatedAmount}, #{remark})
mapper.select: SELECT r.*, c.customer_name FROM receipt r LEFT JOIN customer c ON r.customer_id = c.id WHERE r.id = #{id}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM receipt WHERE order_id = #{orderId}
